families.name: surface
families.label: Surface
families.note: framing and grouping, with the parts a card is composed from

families.name: forms
families.label: Forms
families.note: the frame around a field, and the choice controls

families.name: tables
families.label: Tables
families.note: the described table and the windowed, source-driven ones

families.name: trees
families.label: Trees
families.note: a hierarchy described as nodes rather than windowed as rows

families.name: navigation
families.label: Navigation
families.note: moving between places and through steps

props.name: Label
props.note: the node's caption

props.name: Detail
props.note: secondary text beside the label, or a tooltip where there is no room

props.name: Value
props.note: what a field holds or a display shows; numeric for a slider, a number entry and a rating

props.name: Placeholder
props.note: prompt shown by an empty field

props.name: Help
props.note: explanation revealed by a pointer

props.name: Icon
props.note: named icon

props.name: Tooltip
props.note: explanation revealed by a pointer

props.name: Uri
props.note: the address a link points at, or the file a picture or a video plays

props.name: Enabled
props.note: defaults to enabled when absent

props.name: Visible
props.note: defaults to visible when absent

props.name: Selected
props.note: read like Checked

props.name: Checked
props.note: for a check button, a toggle button or a switch

props.name: Expanded
props.note: for an expander or a revealed panel

props.name: Busy
props.note: runs a spinner; defaults to busy when absent

props.name: Secret
props.note: hides typed text, and on a password entry withholds the peek icon

props.name: Destructive
props.note: marks an action as irreversible so automation requires confirmation

props.name: Monospace
props.note: for a text view; defaults to monospace when absent

props.name: Wrap
props.note: words onto further lines for text, whole children for a row or a column

props.name: Ellipsize
props.note: for a label

props.name: Variant
props.note: emphasis level

props.name: Tone
props.note: semantic weight

props.name: Scale
props.note: text size role

props.name: Color
props.note: a semantic color slot, never a literal color

props.name: Gap
props.note: space between children; only a Step length has a pixel size

props.name: Pad
props.note: a Length applies to all four sides; Edges names them separately

props.name: Grow
props.note: any value above zero expands the child on both axes

props.name: Width
props.note: an exact extent, or a floor and a ceiling

props.name: Height
props.note: an exact extent, or a floor and a ceiling

props.name: Align
props.note: placement along the main axis

props.name: Justify
props.note: placement along the cross axis

props.name: Columns
props.note: grid column count, or a table's declared column count; never below one

props.name: Span
props.note: grid columns this child occupies; never below one

props.name: RowSpan
props.note: grid rows this child occupies; never below one

props.name: Orientation
props.note: axis of a container, a splitter or a divider

props.name: Position
props.note: the divider position of a splitter, in pixels

props.name: Minimum
props.note: lower bound of a slider or a number entry

props.name: Maximum
props.note: upper bound of a slider or a number entry

props.name: Step
props.note: increment of a slider or a number entry

props.name: Fraction
props.note: progress or meter fill, clamped to nought through one

props.name: Schema
props.note: table columns: key, title, width as a Length, align, sortable

props.name: Source
props.note: identity of the windowed row source backing a collection

props.name: RowHeight
props.note: row height of a windowed collection

props.name: Choices
props.note: options of a select or a radio group, each a value and a label

lengths.note: steps on the 4px spacing scale; higher steps clamp
expand to fill the available space

notes.values: A property's value shapes are the PropValue variants an adapter reads for it. Sending another shape is not an error; it is ignored.
notes.lengthEncoding: A Length is an externally tagged enum: {"Step": 2}, {"Chars": 20}, "Fill", "Content".
notes.logViewRetention: LogView Value patches append; renderers retain only the newest 4096 Unicode characters.
